name: convo_v4_get_portfolio
description: Look up a client's portfolio from the mock API with an HTTP task. Used as a sub workflow by convo_v4_chat_turn and exposed as the MCP tool get_portfolio.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.resp | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $r | if $r.statusCode == 200 and ($r.body | type) == "object" then {found: ($r.body.found == true), portfolio: (if $r.body.found == true then $r.body else null end), known: ($r.body.known // null), error: null} elif $r.statusCode == 404 then {found: false, portfolio: null, known: null, error: null} else {found: false, portfolio: null, known: null, error: "portfolio service unavailable"} end
